title: Amtrak and NNSA system readings preserve independent evidence decisions
summary: Two retained parent contexts gain twelve substantive sections without becoming counted places. Installation, closeout, asset reliability, enterprise baselines, accepted capacity and recurring output retain their own populations and dates.
evidence_note: Nineteen retained source-check records from five saved receipts support the November 22 authored and AI self-reviewed synthesis. October 28 reliability/recurring-output inspections remain distinct from November 21 closeout/baseline/capacity inspections. No future November 25 gate was run. Repeated URLs retain their separate dated inspection scope; the shared NNSA overview is not claimed as a second November fetch.
publication_effect: The national rail network and disconnected two-site parent remain Context with zero eligible-place contribution. No new cycle identity, Phase 61 named file, source inspection, operating outcome or stage admission. The preceding six readings and assessments remain exact; production, release, owner launch and actual stewardship are still open.
